outcome: ordinary control sequence incomplete; selected execution not established; packet result inconclusive
observations: The actual Windows guest booted and returned authenticated controller receipts. Production binary build/size gates passed; host payload/capture-capacity admission reported true, establishing configured P<=24MiB/reserve acceptance but not an exact package size.

The held owned QEMU mapped backing-file/local package agreement admitted before the existing link-up path. Pre-stop verification and descriptor close were true. QEMU package1:8.2.2+ds-0ubuntu1.18 and libslirp4.7.0-1ubuntu3.1 are separately reported local metadata/integrity, not resident-image or upstream-source proof.

The owned runner IPv6 receiver observed one exact nonce-bound ordinary-before datagram and returned one echo without send error. This supports that individual ordinary outgoing guest-to-owned-runner observation; it does not prove the native guest accepted the reply or full bidirectional calibration.

Before report profile/provenance flags were true; later-phase flags were false. Those flags do not export per-phase envelope/report presence and can also reflect malformed or unbound data. No verified later-phase or selected invocation is established; false/zero fields are not observed failed contained sends or isolation. The exact internal stop or attempted-launch boundary is not exported; outer completed/failed=false describes wrapper completion only.
No admitted full four-report private bundle was available: flow commitment missing, packet null/inconclusive. No PCAP decoding or bounded absence conclusion is reported.

Published QEMU and TPM exits were0; receiver, server, watcher, QMP and work cleanup were confirmed, with teardown error_count0. Original Stage0 remains false solely at capabilities_empty, as in previous experiments.
limits: The closed receipt does not export per-phase envelope/report presence, exact internal driver stage, ordinary-admission predicate or native failure stage. A later phase could fail before report assignment, or a supplied report could fail validation. Private native report/bundle/PCAP were not retained, so no retrospective raw reconstruction is possible.
Receiver echo sent is not native echo accepted; send success is not delivery. No selected PSEC IPv6 send/denial/absence or general IPv6 isolation result.
The observed Windows build26300.9457 remains below documented26300.9550 floor; product/privacy/PSEC cleanup acceptance flags remain false.
Preparation receipt is sampled net capacity, not peak/quota/installed-plan proof. Cleanup facts do not authenticate resident memory or all OS internals.
One authorized first UDP6 guest run; no rerun or networking repair/fallback was launched. Earlier integration fixture failures remain archived. No DNS/proxy/descendant IPv6/Linux/product claim.
interpretation_correction: This wording corrects the earlier summary inference that false later-phase flags proved no reports were returned. Exact three receipt bytes and all measured observations are unchanged.
